9.3.text: Polycarp declared, "Eighty and six years have I served Him, and He never did me any injury: how then can I blaspheme my King and my Saviour?"
9.3.notes: ANF 1. The text gives 86 years of service, not his age. Ch. 15-16: the fire formed an arch and did not consume him; he was killed with a dagger in the stadium at Smyrna.
